chunks: And with this chain of narration, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Abi Jamilah, from Jabir, from Abi Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever conceals testimony, or testifies with it to shed the blood of a Muslim or to usurp the wealth of a Muslim, will come on the Day of Judgment with a darkness on his face extending as far as the eye can see, and scratches on his face, which the creatures will recognize by his name and lineage.'
Abi Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'Do you not see that God, the Mighty and Sublime, says: And give upright testimony for God?'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual consequence of giving false testimony in Islam?
ai.summary: Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (peace be upon him) narrates that the Prophet (peace be upon him) warned that those who give false testimony to shed blood or usurp wealth will face divine punishment on the Day of Judgment, marked by darkness and scratches on their faces. This is supported by the Quranic command to give upright testimony for God. In Shia tradition, this hadith underscores the spiritual gravity of *shahadah* (testimony), linking legal integrity to eschatological visibility, where the witness's true identity and lineage are revealed through their facial marks.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 3.  Imam  Muhammad  Baqir  (a.s.)  narrates  that  the  Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, “One who testifies falsely and as a result of which a Muslim’s blood is shed or his wealth is usurped, the testifier will be brought on the Day of Judgment with  his  face  having  blackness  spread  everywhere  and having scratches on it. People will know him with his name and lineage.

One who testifies truthfully and saves the right of another Muslim, his face will be brightened on the Day of Judgment with its light spreading everywhere on the Day of Judgment. He will also be known to the people with name and  lineage.
Did  you  not  hear  the  saying  of  Allah,  the Mighty   and   Sublime:   and   give   upright   testimony   for Allah?”
